{{short description|French mathematician}}
'''Sandrine Péché''' (born 1977)<ref name="38spa">[https://web.archive.org/web/20150911222339/http://spa2015.oxford-man.ox.ac.uk/people/sandrine-peche Speaker biography], 38th Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications, University of Oxford, retrieved 2016-07-02.</ref> is a French mathematician who works as a professor in the Laboratoire de Probabilités, Statistique et Modélisation of [[Paris Diderot University]].<ref>[http://www.lpsm.paris/dw/doku.php?id=users:peche:index Faculty profile], LPSM, retrieved 2021-04-22.</ref> Her research concerns [[probability theory]], [[mathematical physics]], and the theory and applications of [[random matrix|random matrices]].

After studying at the [[École normale supérieure de Cachan]],<ref name="38spa"/>
Péché earned a Ph.D. from the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] in Switzerland, in 2002, under the supervision of [[Gérard Ben Arous]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=63825}}</ref>
She taught at the [[University of Grenoble]] before moving to Paris Diderot in 2011.<ref name="38spa"/>

She served as the editor-in-chief of ''[[Electronic Communications in Probability]]'' from 2015 to 2017.<ref>[http://www.imstat.org/ecp/ ''Electronic Communications in Probability'' home page], retrieved 2021-04-21.</ref>
She was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2014.<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |date=2017-11-24 }}, [[International Mathematical Union]], retrieved 2016-07-02.</ref>
